ItemDef.Name: consent
ItemDef.redcap:SectionHeader:
Thank you for your interest!
We are recruiting individuals to participate in a 4-week paid research study. This study involves completing brief tasks over your phone and responding to questions about your experiences and daily life.
Before getting started, please read our consent form below for more details. You will then be asked to answer a few brief questions to determine your eligibility to participate.
If you are found eligible, a study team member will contact you with next steps.

Question.TranslatedText: Please read the following consent form and complete the questions below:

Note: If you answer any of the following 5 questions incorrectly, you will be asked to repeat these questions. You will have two more chances to answer them accurately in order to proceed with the study.
True or False? In this study, you will download an application on your phone, complete a series of questionnaires, and create brief recordings.
True or False? This study provides a new treatment to you with clinical support and feedback.
True or False? Only individuals who meet study eligibility criteria can receive compensation.
The information you share with the study will be:
Your total participation in this study will take up to:
CS1 Score
Contact Information
First Name
Last Name
Email address (NOTE: we will send your gift card to this email if eligible and once you have completed all required study procedures)
What is your date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY)?
What zip code do you live in?
What is your highest level of completed education?
Please select the 'fruit' out of the given options:
U01 Project Consent Signing
